Step 1 of 4

Build your workspace

Pick the capabilities you want in your dashboard. Each is a full suite. Open any of them for a guided walkthrough first, then select the ones to include. Most firms take all four.

✦ 
The system learns as you use it. Every edit you make to a draft, every source you tick or untick, and every correction to the wording is captured as a rule, so the work it hands you next time already looks the way you wanted it.
Step 2 of 4

How the system works

The system gathers your real material, drafts important client work, and learns and improves every time you edit.

It gathers

Call transcripts, uploaded documents, portfolio data, and your published content feed every output.

Hover to see how
It drafts

Plans, briefs, reports, and content are drafted in your templates and your brand voice, never from scratch.

Hover to see how
It learns

Every edit you keep can be saved as feedback. The next run adjusts to match how you actually write.

Hover to see how
💡 
You stay in control. Nothing is sent or published without your review, and you decide which edits the system learns from.

Templates

These are the shapes every output follows. They came from the example documents you uploaded during setup, plus every edit you've approved since. They also live in the , inside each folder's Templates subfolder, which is where Canvas pulls from when you build a document.

📄 
How a template works. Your example file gives the section order and heading language. The rules under it are things you told the system to always do. When you edit a finished document and say yes to "should the system learn from this", the change lands here.
